visualCharacteristics.purpose: embedded Marketo lead form (contact / training enquiry)
visualCharacteristics.layout: default: grey #f0f0f0 panel, 20px padding, 13px bold labels above full-width fields, blue #007acb submit; two-column: 720px centered, labels right-aligned in a 35% column beside fields (max 300px), red #ea1c2c submit, stacked below 768px; stacked: no panel, 720px centered, 11px labels above full-width 32px fields, blue #007acb submit on the right
visualCharacteristics.behavior: form script loaded from the form URL's origin when the block nears the viewport; Marketo inline widths and theme stylesheet removed so the form is fluid; block hidden if the URL is invalid or the script fails

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell: link (or plain text) to the Marketo form endpoint https://{host}/index.php/form/getForm?munchkinId={id}&form={formId}

options.label: Two column (labels beside fields, on a grey band)
Stacked (labels above fields, centered, no panel)

reuseGuidance: Use wherever the source embeds a Marketo form (mktoForm). Author only the form URL; the fields come from Marketo. Default = sidebar panel, two-column = wide in-page form on a band, stacked = in-page form with labels above fields.
